name: realtyhub-monorepo
description: Orquestador maestro del ecosistema RealtyHub: API Gateway + 8 microservicios NestJS + Frontend Next.js

scripts.clean: rimraf api-gateway/dist user-service/dist property-service/dist lead-service/dist viewing-service/dist contract-service/dist commission-service/dist notification-service/dist analytics-service/dist
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../api-gateway && npm install && cd ../user-service && npm install && cd ../property-service && npm install && cd ../lead-service && npm install && cd ../viewing-service && npm install && cd ../contract-service && npm install && cd ../commission-service && npm install && cd ../notification-service && npm install && cd ../analytics-service && npm install
scripts.prisma:generate: cd user-service && npx prisma generate && cd ../property-service && npx prisma generate && cd ../lead-service && npx prisma generate && cd ../viewing-service && npx prisma generate && cd ../contract-service && npx prisma generate && cd ../commission-service && npx prisma generate && cd ../notification-service && npx prisma generate && cd ../analytics-service && npx prisma generate
scripts.dev: npm run clean && docker-compose up -d && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold,yellow.bold,blue.bold,green.bold,red.bold,gray.bold,white.bold,yellowBright.bold,cyanBright.bold" -n "GATEWAY,FRONTEND,USER,PROP,LEAD,VIEW,CONTR,COMM,NOTIF,ANALY" "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:user" "npm run start:property" "npm run start:lead" "npm run start:viewing" "npm run start:contract" "npm run start:commission" "npm run start:notification" "npm run start:analytics"
